entities.name: okie
entities.responsibility: Spatial explanation system that scans a repository into an evidence-backed C4 atlas and plays deterministic guided stories from system context down to source.

entities.name: @okie/server
entities.responsibility: Loopback scan HTTP process that serves paste-a-repo jobs, published scan objects, and optional Ask Atlas answers against an OpenAI-compatible gateway. GET /healthz stays key-free.

entities.name: @okie/web
entities.responsibility: React browser shell that renders the C4 atlas, plays deterministic guided stories, and hosts the inspector, source viewer, and paste-a-repo landing.

entities.name: atlas-engine
entities.responsibility: CPU scene engine for retained atlas state, LOD, culling, hit-testing, patches, and timeline playback, with no GPU or browser dependencies.

entities.name: atlas-gpu
entities.responsibility: wgpu renderer (WebGPU with WebGL2-safe limits) that owns mesh building, the glyph atlas, and GPU surface selection.

entities.name: atlas-protocol
entities.responsibility: Versioned v1 camelCase renderer protocol for scenes, patches, geometry, and timelines — the Rust source of truth mirrored in TypeScript.

entities.name: atlas-wasm
entities.responsibility: wasm-bindgen browser bridge that exposes create_atlas_renderer for the web shell; pkg/ is generated by scripts/build-wasm.mjs.

entities.name: @okie/architecture
entities.responsibility: Canonical renderer-independent architecture model: extraction schema, snapshot validation, C4 projection, completeness scoring, and orthogonal routing.

entities.name: @okie/scan
entities.responsibility: Deterministic TypeScript scanner that pins a git tree, emits bounded enrichment packets and concatenated prompts, and merges accepted ArchitectureExtraction documents through an atomic gate.

entities.name: @okie/scene-compiler
entities.responsibility: Compiles architecture snapshots and stories into the v1 renderer scene protocol, C4 dynamic-flow artifacts, and the hand-authored golden demo fixture.

entities.name: Build & fixture tooling
entities.responsibility: Repo-level generators that rebuild gitignored wasm-pack output and a seeded stress scene before check, build, and dev.
